  "version": "0.1.0",
  "type": "module",

    "node": ">=22"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "vite",
    "build": "tsc -b tsconfig.kit.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/check-design-contract.mjs && node scripts/check-ui-contract.mjs && vite build && node scripts/build-sw.mjs dist && node scripts/check-budget.mjs && node scripts/check-entry-graph.mjs dist",
    "preview": "vite preview",
    "lint": "eslint .",
    "test": "vitest run",
    "coverage": "vitest run --coverage --testTimeout=120000 --reporter=default --reporter=json --outputFile.json=coverage/test-results.json",
    "gate": "npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test && npm run coverage && E2E_SKIP_BUILD=1 npm run test:e2e && E2E_SKIP_BUILD=1 npm run test:deploy",
    "test:watch": "vitest",
    "test:e2e": "playwright test --project=chromium --grep @smoke",
    "test:deploy": "playwright test --config playwright.subpath.config.ts",
    "golden:regenerate": "vite-node tests/golden/regenerate.ts",
    "bench": "vitest run --config vitest.timing.config.ts",
    "test:e2e:full": "playwright test",

    "margins": "vite-node scripts/landing-margins.ts",
